title.zh: 将萨马省帕拉帕格市镇尼帕村尼帕村学校的名称变更为Bernabe Quibal纪念社区学校的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Nipa Barrio School in the Barrio of Nipa, Municipality of Palapag, Province of Samar, to Bernabe Quibal Memorial Community School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Nipa Barrio School in the Barrio of Nipa, Municipality of Palapag, Province of Samar, to Bernabe Quibal Memorial Community School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Nipa Barrio School tại Barrio Nipa, Thị trấn Palapag, Tỉnh Samar thành Bernabe Quibal Memorial Community School
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อ Nipa Barrio School ในบารริโอ Nipa, เทศบาล Palapag, จังหวัด Samar เป็น Bernabe Quibal Memorial Community School
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Nipa Barrio School di Barrio Nipa, Kotamadya Palapag, Provinsi Samar menjadi Bernabe Quibal Memorial Community School
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Nipa Barrio School di Barrio Nipa, Perbandaran Palapag, Wilayah Samar menjadi Bernabe Quibal Memorial Community School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1960/ra_2773_1960.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Nipa Barrio School in the barrio of Nipa, Municipality of Palapag, Province of Samar, is changed to Bernabe Quibal Memorial Community School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1960.
